preconditions.description: The number of cities n and roads m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range [1, n].
The number of edges provided matches m.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate roads between any pair of cities.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for comp in connected_components if len(comp) == 1 and not any(e[0] in comp or e[1] in comp for e in edges))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of connected components that consist of a single isolated vertex (no edges incident to it). This is the minimum number of separate cities because any component with at least one edge can be oriented to have zero separate cities (e.g., by forming a path or cycle), while an isolated vertex must remain separate.
